meta.name: publish
meta.description: Publish oh-my-opencode to npm by triggering the GitHub Actions publish workflow and verifying its artifacts. Ship-only: never runs pre-publish-review or re-reviews merged code unless the user explicitly asks. Argument: <patch|minor|major|explicit-semver>. Triggers: publish, release, deploy, npm publish.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把新版本发布到 npm 并确认发布成功
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果发布了新版本后需要确认它真正上线了
copy.tagline_en: Publish a new version to npm and confirm the release succeeded
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ship a new version and verify it went live

howto.what: 装上后，你说要发布，它会走完整发布流程：触发 GitHub Actions、等 CI 检查通过、核对 GitHub Release 和 npm 包版本、写发布摘要，并尝试在 Discord 发公告。它只负责发布，不审查或改动代码。
howto.when: 当你说 publish、release、deploy 等词，或要求发布到 npm 时触发；你必须提供 patch、minor、major 或显式版本号，否则它会先停下来问你。

say.text: 请发布一个 patch 版本。
say.note: 触发补丁版本发布流程。

say.text: 发布一个 minor 版本到 npm。
say.note: 触发新功能小版本的完整发版流程。
按指定预发布版本号触发发布流程。

howto.what_en: On a publish request, it runs the full workflow: trigger GitHub Actions, wait for CI, verify GitHub Release and npm versions, write a release summary, and attempt a Discord post. Ship-only, no reviews or code changes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say publish, release, deploy, or ask for an npm publish. You must specify patch, minor, major, or an exact version; otherwise it asks first.

say_en.text: Publish a minor version to npm.
say_en.note: Triggers the full minor release flow.
Runs the workflow with your specified version.
